items.name: bifrost-fresh-cache
items.description: Geek Room Global AI Hackathon 2026 (Track A, Problem 04): a Postgres/pgvector cache backend for the Bifrost AI gateway, plus a companion that uses Tavily to check cached AI answers against live web pages and blocks wrong or out-of-date answers.

items.name: DiscoveryBrief
items.description: DiscoveryBrief - evidence-based preparation for enterprise discovery meetings: recent company developments, literal RFP requirements, questions, tentative hypotheses and unknowns in a one-page brief. This project is using Tavily Search + Extract and also Bifrost OSS as AI gateway.

items.name: leantoken
items.description: Coding agent that completes dev tasks on the fewest tokens

items.name: staleguard
items.description: Is this AI answer still true today? A stale-answer detector that splits LLM answers into claims, flags time-sensitive ones (pricing, API versions, laws, leadership), verifies them live with Tavily, and gives each a 0–100 freshness score with cited evidence. Every model call through the Bifrost gateway. 18/18 on a labelled eval.

items.name: crucible
items.description: Chaos-test your AI agents before production does. A framework-independent benchmarking platform that runs AI agents on identical tasks, injects failing tools, model outages and misleading data, and scores how they survive — with 95% confidence intervals. Every model call routed through the Bifrost gateway to Sarvam.

items.name: agentbench-arena
items.description: Reliability benchmark for AI agents under tool failures: fault injection, repeated runs, execution traces and a reliability score. Integrates Bifrost and Tavily; headline results run in simulation mode

items.name: freshguard
items.description: Catch stale facts in LLM answers at the AI gateway — a Bifrost plugin that re-verifies time-sensitive claims with Tavily

items.name: agent-gauntlet
items.description: A benchmarking platform for AI agents, not just models. Built on the open-source Bifrost gateway. Geek Room Global AI Hackathon (Bifrost track).

items.name: stilltrue
items.description: Freshness firewall for AI answers — claim-level audit against live sources, sided by Bifrost (Maxim AI) + Tavily

items.name: tavily-research-agent
items.description: Tavily Research Agent: pre-meeting briefings from the last 30 days, built for the Geek Room Global AI Hackathon
